title: WaiversConfig
description: Schema for accepted risk waivers (.sfaudit-waivers.json or --waivers) in @cclabsnz/sf-audit.

findingId.description: Limit the waiver to one finding id of the check.

entity.description: Exact affected-item label (case-insensitive), or the finding id for a finding with no affected items. No wildcards.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 date or timestamp, at most 365 days after the audit runs.

acknowledgeCritical.description: Required (true) to waive a CRITICAL finding.
